Title: User registers with mobile OTP
Preconditions: Database is seeded, backend and frontend are running
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page | 2. Enter valid mobile number | 3. Click 'Send OTP' | 4. Copy the demo OTP from response | 5. Enter OTP | 6. Click 'Verify & Login'
Expected Result: User successfully registers and is logged in with session token stored. Redirected to Movies page.

Title: Search movies by title
Preconditions: User is logged in, demo data is seeded
Steps: 1. Navigate to Movies tab | 2. Enter 'Inception' in search field | 3. Click 'Search' button
Expected Result: Only 'Inception' movie is displayed in results with correct title, genre, rating, and poster.

Title: Filter movies by genre and language
Preconditions: User is logged in, demo data is seeded
Steps: 1. Navigate to Movies tab | 2. Select 'Sci-Fi' from Genre dropdown | 3. Select 'English' from Language dropdown | 4. Click 'Search' button
Expected Result: Movies matching both filters are displayed (Inception, Interstellar). Action movies are not shown.

Title: Add food items to cart and checkout
Preconditions: User is logged in, demo data is seeded
Steps: 1. Navigate to Food Menu tab | 2. Click 'Add to Cart' on Large Popcorn | 3. Click 'Add to Cart' on Coca Cola | 4. Click Cart button in header | 5. Verify items and total price | 6. Click 'Checkout' button
Expected Result: Cart shows 2 items with total $13.98. After checkout, success message displays and cart clears. Order is created in database.

Title: View theatre 360-degree tour
Preconditions: User is logged in, demo data is seeded, theatre has 360 view available
Steps: 1. Navigate to Theatres tab | 2. Click 'View 360° Tour' button on Oktawave Cinema Downtown | 3. Observe 360 image and metadata
Expected Result: 360-degree theatre image loads successfully. Metadata shows resolution (2048x1024) and capture date. User can see immersive theatre view.

Title: Complete movie booking with food order flow
Preconditions: User is not logged in, database is seeded
Steps: 1. Register new user with mobile OTP | 2. Search for 'Interstellar' movie | 3. Click 'Book Now' button | 4. Select 2 premium seats | 5. Observe dynamic pricing | 6. Add food items (Popcorn, Nachos) | 7. Complete checkout for both booking and food
Test Data: Mobile: 9876543210, Movie: Interstellar, Seats: 2 premium, Food: Popcorn + Nachos
Expected Result: User successfully completes end-to-end flow from registration to final booking. Dynamic pricing applied to seats based on occupancy. Food order linked to booking. Total cost calculated correctly.

Title: Browse theatres and view 360 tour before booking
Preconditions: User is logged in, theatres are seeded
Steps: 1. Navigate to Theatres tab | 2. Browse all available theatres | 3. Select Oktawave IMAX theatre | 4. Click '360° Tour' button | 5. Explore interactive view | 6. Click back and proceed to movies
Expected Result: User can browse theatres by city, view complete details (name, address, screens). 360 tour loads for theatres with view_360 data. Navigation flow works seamlessly.

Title: OTP expires after 5 minutes
Preconditions: User initiates registration, waits 6+ minutes before entering OTP
Steps: 1. Enter mobile number | 2. Click 'Send OTP' | 3. Wait 6 minutes | 4. Enter the OTP code | 5. Click 'Verify & Login'
Expected Result: Error message displays: 'OTP has expired'. User must request new OTP. No session is created.

Title: Search with no matching results
Preconditions: User is logged in, demo data is seeded
Steps: 1. Navigate to Movies tab | 2. Enter non-existent movie title in search | 3. Click 'Search' button
Expected Result: Message displays: 'No movies found. Try different filters.' Empty state shown with no movie cards. No errors in console.

Title: Filter movies with minimum rating 9.0
Preconditions: User is logged in, demo data is seeded with ratings (8.8, 9.0, 8.6)
Steps: 1. Navigate to Movies tab | 2. Select '9+' from Min Rating dropdown | 3. Click 'Search' button
Expected Result: Only 'The Dark Knight' (rating 9.0) is displayed. Movies with rating 8.8 and 8.6 are filtered out. Count shows '1'.

Title: Update cart item quantity to zero
Preconditions: User has items in cart
Steps: 1. Add Large Popcorn to cart | 2. Click Cart button | 3. Click minus (-) button until quantity reaches 0
Expected Result: Item is automatically removed from cart when quantity reaches 0. Cart count updates. Total price recalculates correctly to $0.00 if cart becomes empty.

Title: Dynamic pricing with 90%+ occupancy
Preconditions: Show exists with 50 total seats, 45 seats already booked (90% occupancy)
Steps: 1. Navigate to booking page for show_1 | 2. View available seats | 3. Observe current_price vs base_price
Expected Result: Current price is 1.5x base price = $150. Premium seats (base $150) show $225. Price multiplier applies correctly. Occupancy rate displays as 90%.

Title: Dynamic pricing with low occupancy (under 20%)
Preconditions: Show has 50 seats, only 8 seats booked (16% occupancy)
Steps: 1. Navigate to booking page | 2. View seat prices
Expected Result: Discount pricing applied. Seats show current_price = 0.85x base_price. Regular seat ($100 base) shows $85. Encourages bookings during low demand.

Title: Multiple genre and language filters combined
Preconditions: User is logged in, diverse movies are seeded
Steps: 1. Select 'Sci-Fi' genre | 2. Select 'English' language | 3. Select '8+' minimum rating | 4. Click Search
Test Data: Genre: Sci-Fi, Language: English, Min Rating: 8
Expected Result: Backend combines all filter criteria with AND logic. Returns only movies matching all three conditions. Query performance is optimized with database indexes.

Title: Add multiple quantities of same food item
Preconditions: User is logged in, food menu is loaded
Steps: 1. Click 'Add to Cart' on Nachos | 2. Click 'Add to Cart' on Nachos again (3 times total) | 3. Open cart | 4. Verify quantity
Expected Result: Cart shows single line item for Nachos with quantity = 3. Subtotal calculates as $6.99 × 3 = $20.97. Quantity controls (+ and -) work correctly.

Title: Filter food menu by category
Preconditions: User is logged in, food items are seeded
Steps: 1. Navigate to Food Menu tab | 2. Select 'Beverages' from Category dropdown
Expected Result: Only beverage items (Coca Cola, etc.) are displayed. Snacks and Food items are filtered out. Category filter works independently.

Title: Reset movie filters to view all movies
Preconditions: User has applied filters that reduce results
Steps: 1. Apply filters (Genre: Action, Min Rating: 9) | 2. View filtered results | 3. Click 'Reset' button
Expected Result: All filters clear to default empty/null values. All movies display again regardless of genre or rating. Search input field clears. Count returns to total movies (3).

Title: View theatre without 360 view available
Preconditions: User views theatre that lacks view_360 data
Steps: 1. Navigate to Theatres tab | 2. Observe theatre card without 360 view | 3. Verify no '360° Tour' button appears
Expected Result: Theatre card displays name, city, address correctly. 'has_360_view' is false. No 360 tour button renders. No errors or broken UI elements.

Title: Login with invalid OTP
Preconditions: User receives OTP but enters wrong code
Steps: 1. Enter mobile number and receive OTP | 2. Enter incorrect 6-digit code | 3. Click 'Verify & Login'
Expected Result: Error message: 'Invalid OTP'. User remains on OTP entry screen. No session token created. No access to protected routes.

Title: Register with invalid mobile number format
Preconditions: User attempts registration with malformed number
Steps: 1. Enter mobile number with special characters or letters | 2. Click 'Send OTP'
Expected Result: Frontend validation prevents submission OR backend returns 400 error: 'Invalid mobile number format'. No OTP generated. User prompted to correct input.

Title: Search movies without authentication
Preconditions: User is not logged in, tries to access /movies endpoint directly
Steps: 1. Clear localStorage (logout) | 2. Attempt to navigate to Movies tab via URL manipulation
Expected Result: User is redirected to login page OR Movies page displays login prompt. Protected API endpoints return 401 Unauthorized. No movie data is exposed.

Title: Checkout empty food cart
Preconditions: User opens cart with zero items and clicks checkout
Steps: 1. Ensure cart is empty | 2. Click 'Checkout' button
Expected Result: Checkout button is disabled when cart is empty OR error message displays: 'Cart is empty'. No order is created in database. Prevents empty transactions.

Title: Book seats that are already booked
Preconditions: Two users attempt to book same seats simultaneously
Steps: 1. User A selects seat A1 | 2. User B selects seat A1 before User A completes booking | 3. User A attempts to confirm booking
Expected Result: Backend validates seat availability before booking. Returns 400 error: 'Some seats are not available'. User A must select different seats. Prevents double-booking race condition.

Title: Access 360 view for non-existent theatre
Preconditions: User attempts to access /api/theatres/invalid_id/360-view
Steps: 1. Call 360-view endpoint with invalid theatre_id
Expected Result: API returns 404 error: 'Theatre not found'. Frontend displays error message: 'Failed to load 360° view'. No application crash or undefined errors.

Title: Filter movies with conflicting criteria
Preconditions: User applies filters that cannot match any movie
Steps: 1. Select Genre: 'Action' | 2. Select Language: 'French' | 3. Select Min Rating: 9+ | 4. Click Search
Test Data: Filters: Action + French + 9+ rating (no movies match all)
Expected Result: Empty results with message: 'No movies found. Try different filters.' Count shows 0. No backend errors. User can reset filters to recover.
